name: Cooper Steel Fabricators Inc
old_description: Founded in 1960, Cooper Steel is a national leader in structural steel fabrication and erection. Our team of skilled tradespeople, project managers, estimators, and detailers have helped set and exceed industry standards for more than 65 years – never settling for good enough. With experience building in sectors including manufacturing, distribution, aerospace, commercial, and more, we’re equipped and ready to take on any challenge.
about:
Cooper Steel Fabricators Inc operates from its headquarters in Shelbyville, Tennessee, with additional fabrication facilities in Childersburg, Alabama, and Monroe, Virginia. The company was founded in 1960 and has remained a family-owned and operated business for over six decades. Leadership today includes Gary Cooper as chief executive officer and chairman, alongside second-generation family members serving as chief operations officer, chief financial officer, and chief administrative officer.

The firm specializes in structural steel fabrication and erection, offering preconstruction, project management, field operations, and self-perform erection services. Its three fabrication shops provide more than 385,000 square feet of operational space, and the company ranks among the top 15 purchasers of mill-produced steel in the United States. Capabilities include robotic fabrication, plate girder and truss production, oversized assemblies, specialty coatings, and BIM-enabled detailing and connection design.

Cooper Steel serves sectors such as manufacturing, distribution, aerospace, commercial, food and beverage, and mission-critical infrastructure. Its project portfolio includes major distribution facilities and mission-critical structures for national companies. The company's 24/7 project management teams and in-house erection crews with dedicated safety personnel and certified welding inspectors differentiate it from fabricators that subcontract erection.

The company's founding principle—“Give Big, Expect Little”—reflects a culture that prioritizes relationships and community. A safety program recognized with multiple AISC and SEAA awards, including Erector Safety Award of Honor honors across several years, underscores its commitment to workforce well-being alongside on-time delivery.
